decision.reason: H14 improved aggregate and quarter evidence but retained three negative late folds, a deeply negative bear regime, and unavailable mandatory score-IC evidence. The exact preregistration requires the old family to stop. One formal pivot is justified because the positive bull/chop aggregate evidence motivates a falsifiable hypothesis that unconditional residual continuation in bear is the defect; it does not prove that diagnosis.

folds.derivation: Approximate compounded fold returns derived directly from canonical bar-return boundary equities; signs and the 3/6 count are exact.

next_pivot_specification.falsifier: Reject the no-control pivot reference with no risk rescue if it is incomplete or insolvent; aggregate net Sharpe is nonpositive; fewer than four of six folds have positive net return; bull, bear, or chop net return is nonpositive; long attribution in bull, short attribution in bear, or combined attribution in chop is nonpositive; fewer than three regime Sharpes are positive; or worst-regime Sharpe is below -0.25. The bear branch must also make bear return and short-bear attribution positive relative to the completed all-residual H14 comparator. Failure stops this pivot reference before construction or risk controls and requires DNF or a separately registered second and final mechanism pivot.

mechanism.bear_score: Path-efficient standardized 14-day raw asset log-return trend ending three days before the decision.
mechanism.bull_and_chop_score: The existing path-efficient standardized 14-day BTC-residual drift ending three days before the decision.
mechanism.direction_state: Using only closed BTC bars through t-1 day, bull when the trailing 60-day BTC log return is at least +0.10, bear when at most -0.10, otherwise chop.
mechanism.funding_adjustment: Subtract 0.35 times the robust cross-sectional z-score of the trailing seven-day realized funding sum in every state.
mechanism.scientific_delta: Only the bear-state ranking changes from BTC-residual continuation to absolute downside trend. This is a formal state-dependent mechanism pivot, not another old-family cell.

next_pivot_specification.portfolio_construction: Select signed top/bottom score tails and apply contemporaneous 20/80-winsorized inverse signal-volatility capped-simplex weights. Retain the causal clipped BTC direction sleeve tilt of 0.075, so both sleeves remain live.
next_pivot_specification.risk_controls: none for the reference; if and only if the no-control causal and role gates pass, preregister a separate base/double-cost matrix for a 20% annualized volatility target and the existing 10%/18%/25% drawdown brakes.
next_pivot_specification.selection_metric_if_multiple_candidates_: 25th percentile of six fold net Sharpes plus 0.25 times doubled-cost aggregate Sharpe; mandatory gates remain non-compensatory.
